description: main-refresh: on every UserPromptSubmit, keep the local main checkout at origin/main for repositories that have at least one Claude worktree. The hook consumes stdin, exits 0 on every path, skips cloud sessions (CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true), non-git directories and repositories without an origin, debounces a detached background fetch of origin to once per 300 s (marker file in the git common dir), then runs apply --quiet and forwards its MAIN_REFRESH lines unchanged. It runs the repository's own scripts/main-refresh.sh when the repository ships one, and the plugin's copy only when it ships none. The repository's script can enroll, siphon and restore listed paths and remove a stale lock, and it can repeat its whole-tree analysis up to three times in one run, so the timeout is 120 s. The plugin's own copy fast-forwards only when no local file is touched and prints a MAIN_REFRESH_FIX hint for BLOCKED and DIVERGED states.
